summary.text: Ron Gray was first elected in 2012 to represent Delaware House District 38, which includes Bethany Beach, Fenwick Island, Selbyville and Ocean View.

paragraphs.text: According to his official page, Gray owns R.E. Gray & Associates Engineering Co. and is a professional engineer licensed in Delaware, Maryland and Virginia; he lives in Selbyville.
He holds a bachelor's degree in civil engineering from the University of Delaware and an MBA from Indiana University.
